preToolExecution.command: bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.env|*.env.*|*/.env|*/.env.*|*/secrets/*|*/secrets.*|*secret*|CNAME) echo "BLOCKED: Protected file - $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; exit 1;; esac'
preToolExecution.description: Block edits to .env files, secrets, and CNAME

postToolExecution.command: bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.md|*.mdx|*.css) npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
